problem: How can “done” identify the correct task/run/version, duplicate or late result?
principle: Bind messages to task/run, authenticated endpoints, schema, causation, deadline and artifact references. Delivery and business-effect idempotency are separate.
check: Does MCP replace all Agent messaging?
answer: No. Handoff ownership, causation, artifacts and execution state remain application contracts.
scope: Design reference and local contracts; no model training or measured collaboration uplift.
